title: Severe Canine Anemia at AB-Vet Buneba | BHOC Veterinary
description: Dr. Daria Janiashvili cared for a dog with severe anemia at AB-Vet Buneba in Tbilisi. The August case is part of an ongoing veterinary collaboration.
heading: Severe Canine Anemia at AB-Vet Buneba
lead: Dr. Daria Janiashvili and the AB-Vet Buneba team cared for a dog brought to their clinic in Tbilisi in life-threatening condition.

paragraphs.text: The reported hemoglobin level before treatment was 40 g/L. The team used investigational BHOC (Biological Hemoglobin Oxygen Carrier) to support oxygen delivery while veterinary care continued.
In the team’s account, that support helped buy time for the dog, which went on to recover. A follow-up complete blood count on August 19 recorded hemoglobin of 119 g/L.
Thank you to Dr. Daria Janiashvili and her colleagues for caring for this patient and documenting its course. Our work with AB-Vet Buneba continues this November.
